title: The Gargoyle's Greedy Tithe
story: At the cliff-gate of Windvault, a stone gargoyle named Brollimund flaps down onto the salt caravan and demands his ancient tithe before anyone may pass. The six caravan drivers groan — whatever is left must still be split evenly among them. Mr 6 taps his chin, borrows a stick of chalk, and starts figuring on the gate stones.
question: The caravan carries 120 amber chits, Brollimund's tithe takes 35% of them, and the rest is shared equally among the 6 drivers. How many amber chits does each driver receive?
solution: The tithe is 35% of 120 = 42 chits, so 120 - 42 = 78 chits are left.
Each driver takes home 13 amber chits.
praise: Finding 35% first was the right move — the last step was splitting what REMAINS, not the tithe itself.
hint: First work out how many chits Brollimund keeps, then see how many are left before you divide by 6.
victory: Mr 6 shows Brollimund that a 35% tithe of a caravan that stops coming is 35% of nothing. The gargoyle blinks, lowers his fee to a friendly handshake, and waves the wagons through.
imagePrompt: A winged stone gargoyle perched on a cliff gate at sunset counting amber coins while a brave numeral-6 knight chalks percentages on the gate stones and six caravan drivers watch hopefully.
